title: Psyche Town
description: Each person's psyche is a little orrery: the ego as a sun (shaped by an Enneagram type) inside a persona shield, archetypes as planets whose pull decides who's in charge, aspects as psychological weather. Plus a town where those forces play out, a lab, and a wiki.
summary: Psyches as little orreries (archetypes as planets, aspects as weather) in a town where those forces seize people and, usually, let them go.
